covenant.quote: SECTION 10.08. Financial Maintenance Covenant. Borrower shall not permit the Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter of Borrower commencing with the first full fiscal quarter ending after the Closing Date to exceed 3.75 to 1.00.

thresholds.quote: Borrower shall not permit the Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter to exceed (A) for the fiscal quarter of the Borrower ended March 31, 2020, 3.75 to 1.00 and (B)
(w) for the first fiscal quarter of the Financial Covenant Increase Period, 4.50 to 1.00
(x) for the second fiscal quarter of the Financial Covenant Increase Period, 4.25 to 1.00
(y) for the third fiscal quarter of the Financial Covenant Increase Period, 4.00 to 1.00

(z) for each subsequent fiscal quarter thereafter (including from and including the first fiscal quarter during which the Financial Covenant Increase Period has been terminated by the Borrower pursuant to the definition thereof), 3.75 to 1.00.

relief_period.quote: "Financial Covenant Relief Period" shall mean the period commencing on the Section 2.1 Effective Date and ending on the earlier of (x) the first day of the fiscal quarter beginning April 1, 2022

increase_period.quote: "Financial Covenant Increase Period" shall mean the period commencing on the first day after the expiration of the Financial Covenant Relief Period and ending on the earlier of (x) the first day of the fourth fiscal quarter after the expiration of the Financial Covenant Relief Period

relief_extension.quote: replacing the term "April 1, 2021" contained in clause (x) thereof with the term "April 1, 2022".

ratio_definition.quote: Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio" shall mean, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) (i) Consolidated Indebtedness of Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries that is secured by Liens

ratio_definition_2.quote: minus (ii) Unrestricted Operating Cash to (b) Consolidated EBITDA for the Test Period most recently ended prior to such date

covenant.quote: Minimum Liquidity Covenant. At all times during the Financial Covenant Relief Period, Borrower shall not permit Liquidity at any time to be less than $300,000,000.

thresholds.quote: Borrower shall not permit Liquidity at any time to be less than $300,000,000.
Section 10.13 of the Existing Credit Agreement is hereby amended by replacing the term "$300,000,000" contained therein with the term "$325,000,000".

latest_text.quote: At all times during the Financial Covenant Relief Period, Borrower shall not permit Liquidity at any time to be less than $325,000,000.

terms.note: numerator = first-lien (pari passu with Obligations) secured Consolidated Indebtedness minus Unrestricted Operating Cash; denominator = Consolidated EBITDA for the Test Period.

evidence.quote: Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio" shall mean, as of any date of determination, the ratio of (a) (i) Consolidated Indebtedness of Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries that is secured by Liens

evidence.quote: consisting of Indebtedness for borrowed money, obligations in respect of Capital Leases, purchase money Indebtedness, Indebtedness of the kind described in clause (d) of the definition of "Indebtedness," Indebtedness evidenced by promissory notes and similar instruments and Contingent Obligations in respect of any of the foregoing (to be included only to the extent set forth in clause (iii) below) minus (b) Development Expenses

evidence_more.quote: "Consolidated Indebtedness" shall mean, as at any date of determination, (a) the aggregate amount of all Indebtedness of Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries

evidence.quote: "Unrestricted Operating Cash" shall mean, as of any date of determination, cash and Cash Equivalents of Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries that would not appear as "restricted" on a combined or consolidated balance sheet of the Consolidated Companies in an amount in excess of the Minimum Cage Cash Amount

evidence.quote: "Consolidated EBITDA" shall mean, for any Test Period, the sum (without duplication) of Consolidated Net Income for such Test Period; plus

evidence_more.quote: (i) provisions for taxes based on income or profits or capital gains
(ii) Consolidated Interest Expense of Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries for such Test Period
(viii) any losses resulting from mark to market accounting of Swap Contracts or other derivative instruments; and
(ix) the aggregate amount of accrued and unpaid Management Fees, IP Licensing Fees and Allocable Overhead
(i) non-cash items increasing such Consolidated Net Income for such Test Period
(ii) the amount of any gains resulting from mark to market accounting of Swap Contracts or other derivative instruments; plus

evidence.quote: "Consolidated Interest Expense" shall mean, for any Test Period, the sum of interest expense of Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries for such Test Period as determined on a consolidated basis in accordance with GAAP, plus, to the extent deducted in arriving at Consolidated Net Income and without duplication, (a) the interest portion of payments on Capital Leases

evidence_more.quote: (k) annual or quarterly agency fees paid to Administrative Agent and (l) costs and fees associated with obtaining Swap Contracts and fees payable thereunder.

terms.label: Liquidity

evidence.quote: "Liquidity" means, on any date, the sum of (i) the aggregate amount of Unrestricted Operating Cash of the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries in accordance with GAAP on such date plus (ii) the excess of the aggregate principal amount of Revolving Commitments in effect on such date over the aggregate Revolving Tranche Exposures of all Lenders on such date.

amendments_considered.what_changed: Amendment No. 1 (Apr 10, 2020): Financial Covenant Relief Period (no leverage test) to April 1, 2021, then Financial Covenant Increase Period 4.50/4.25/4.00 then 3.75; new Section 10.13 minimum Liquidity $300M during relief; EBITDA clause (G) cap on Wynn Group Asia dividends ($200.0M) during Increase Period.
Amendment No. 2 (Nov 27, 2020): relief period end moved to April 1, 2022; minimum Liquidity raised to $325M.
Amendment No. 3 (May 17, 2023; conformed copy): Section 10.08/10.13 unchanged; Consolidated Net Income adds cash gaming-lease rent deduction and purchase-accounting exclusion.
Amendment No. 4 (Sep 16, 2024; conformed copy): Section 10.08 text unchanged.
Amendment No. 5 (Jun 12, 2025; conformed copy): Section 10.08 and 10.13 text unchanged; ratio definition unchanged.
